steps.html:
BUILD CONTRACT · OUTSIDE THE PRODUCT
These are portable presentation fixtures, not new domain data, schemas, billing decisions or endpoints. The source-bound retained table rows and Macro summary keep their original values and identities. Counterfactual definition/currency inputs are explicitly separate from the normal Company fixture.
Bind filter clearing, coverage inspection, retry reads, evidence return and saved-object opening to the existing host owner. Error does not erase valid retained rows; source unavailability is not access denial; unknown counts and periods do not become zero. A confirmed save changes the write axis only.
Native application/readback, exact geometry, screenshots, keyboard/ARIA, focus/scroll return, real source integration and actual write readback remain unverified. VirtualizedDataInspector, CountLadder, LifecycleRail and DecisionRow / VerdictHero remain retained and unqualified.
